description: The host is the application (IDE agent, chat app); it runs one MCP client per connected server; each server exposes tools, resources and prompts.
So many tool definitions that they cost significant tokens on every call and degrade the model's tool selection.
Prefixing tool names with a server identifier (`billing__search`) so tools from different servers cannot collide, and keeping a map to route calls back.
List methods may return `nextCursor`; the client sends it back as `cursor` until no cursor is returned.
Offering a search meta-tool and adding only the matching tool definitions to the next request, instead of all of them up front.
A token limit for the tool definitions in one request, enforced when tools are loaded.
A proxy that aggregates several MCP servers behind one endpoint, adding namespacing, filtering, authentication and audit logs.
